reference: Original GQSEAF GameCube executable in Dolphin 2606

source_setup.assets: Original extracted disc; imported assets are not the reference simulator
source_setup.prelude: Declared level 99 party grants, raised vitals, technical route and saved OverLimit; natural battle entry and neutral settling
source_setup.case_mutations: Saved shortcuts and learned masks, idle placement, control mode, unused target controller port and inert case marker; all writes retained in per-case fixture.json
source_setup.movie_policy: One fresh process per distinct input timeline; consumed controller polls compared against retained Dolphin movie

established: Unfinished Fire Ball and First Aid cancellation during normal chains, Manual and Semi-Auto Kratos
Cornered Twin Tiger Blade and Hunting Beast pickups with Demon Fang
Double Demon Fang and Demonic Chaos pickups after cornered Twin Tiger Blade
Failure after slow Beast recovery or distant open-space Twin Tiger Blade
Two successive Twin Tiger Blade pickups joined through an ordinary Demon Fang-to-arcane chain
One airborne admission hold followed by unbraked flight
A longer fixed-timing Twin Tiger Blade loop gets three Demon Fang pickups; the fourth fails after mid-attack knockdown and window expiry
Earlier/repeated Demon Fang inputs do not rescue plain Beast or open-space Twin Tiger Blade on the controlled Zombie
Naturally equipped Follow-up does not rescue either ordinary Demon Fang route on the Zombie

A buffered Beast-to-Demonic Chaos Arcane chain picks up the cornered Zombie with two or six updates of window remaining at the contact visit; waiting for Beast idle or using the open-space setup fails
Open-space Twin Tiger Blade-to-Demon Fang fails against first-stage Sword Dancer and Dragon Knight as well as Zombie
native_additions: Representative Zelos/Kratos spell-cancel cases cover both control modes, one-normal and full chains, with zero prior spell uses
Pickup regressions retain Demon Fang variants, Beast-to-Demonic Chaos timing/position boundaries, Follow-up, and Sword Dancer/Dragon Knight model behavior
Without random stun, Twin Tiger Blade and Hunting Beast loops preserve the combo until window expiry on opposite arena edges, using Manual and Semi-Auto respectively
limits: Controlled Zombie recipient, not every enemy profile or natural AI behavior
Short recorded loops do not establish an unbounded infinite combo
No general certification of all world-space positions, damage, EX setups, aerial spell release or bosses
excluded_experiments: probe/source-run/contact-run/contact-steady: preliminary timing or shared-movie/target-controller experiments; excluded from accepted cases
lloyd-long-repeat-v2: capture exceeded the movie duration and stalled; excluded from accepted evidence
local/battle-physics-gaps-20261103/twin-open-sword-dancer: opening consumed the initial arte input; it never executed and is excluded
Earlier native exploratory probes that dropped published post-contact model requests or removed enemy behavior are superseded by FixtureBattle and the final asset-backed regressions

limits: Six fixed-timing attempts on the controlled Zombie; later contacts include protected damage and a new chain after recovery
Mid-attack knockdown in the fourth Twin Tiger Blade is consistent with accumulated stagger; this is not proof that every Lloyd route has the same limit
cases.native_model_phase: Requests emitted after contact resolution are applied before the next physics update; neutral enemies retain authored model-part behavior
